title.tr: Krem duvar önünde ahşap bahçe merdiveni
title.en: Timber garden staircase against a cream wall

alt.tr: Krem renkli bahçe duvarına yaslanan, çapraz korkuluklu ahşap merdiven ve sol yanda çimenlik
alt.en: Cross-braced timber staircase set against a cream garden wall, with a lawn to its left

caption.tr: Alt bahçeden duvar üstündeki seviyeye çıkan ahşap merdiven. Basamaklar açık, korkuluklar çapraz dikmeli.
caption.en: A timber staircase leading from the lower garden to the level above the wall, with open treads and cross-braced railings.
